description: This is a Java source file defining a utility logging class 'Log' that provides static methods for logging messages at various severity levels and manages a chain of LogNode instances for customizable log handling.

classes.name: Log
classes.description: Utility class providing static methods for logging messages with various severity levels; manages a linked list of LogNode objects for output.

methods.name: getLogNode
methods.description: Returns the current LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setLogNode
methods.description: Sets the LogNode that will handle log output.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Delegates a log message with specified priority, tag, message, and optional Throwable to the current LogNode.

methods.name: v
methods.description: Logs a verbose message, optionally with an exception.

methods.name: d
methods.description: Logs a debug message, optionally with an exception.

methods.name: i
methods.description: Logs an info message, optionally with an exception.

methods.name: w
methods.description: Logs a warning message, optionally with an exception.

methods.name: e
methods.description: Logs an error message, optionally with an exception.

methods.name: wtf
methods.description: Logs an assertion (fatal) message, optionally with an exception.
